post_launch_persistence_evidence: No hard delete of site00_projects anywhere in api/ (only seedDemo deletes next_actions); client list excludes only 'DELETED' which the CHECK forbids -> projects persist indefinitely in DB.
ARCHIVED is the only terminal DB status; there is no LAUNCHED/LIVE/MAINTENANCE status, so a launched project must remain ACTIVE/PRODUCTION or be ARCHIVED.

Because CTRL ROOM and admin queries filter status='ACTIVE', a project moved to PRODUCTION or ARCHIVED disappears from client CTRL ROOM counts/signals — 'launched' effectively behaves like 'gone' in that surface though data persists.

Client app (P0.APP.1) models LIVE/COMPLETE post-launch with 'LIVE FOR N DAYS' + WHAT'S NEXT opportunities, but N is hardcoded 47 and opportunities only log interest — demonstrates intended persistence, not real lifecycle.
Project index understands LAUNCHED/POST_LAUNCH via substring match of current_phase, but nothing writes those phase strings (PHASE_ORDER ends at LAUNCH).
EVOLVE marketing_profiles default lifecycle_stage POST_LAUNCH (org-scoped) — post-launch growth is modeled per organization, not per project/site.
site00_sites FK ON DELETE SET NULL means a site row is designed to outlive its project.

SITE_TO_PROJECT_LINKAGE_today: site00_sites.project_id (nullable FK, ON DELETE SET NULL) + identity_id is the only site<->project link; surfaced only in admin SiteDetailPage (PROJECT + CLIENT panels) and the operator launch queue. Client surfaces never show it. Project has no back-reference (no site list on project; project mission control does not list sites). Existing-location cases use free-text site_url + optional project_id, not site_id. Design control plane uses its own site00_managed_projects registry unlinked to either. Public /sites uses an empty static seed. Net: sites and projects are only loosely joined in the DB and disjoint in the UI; nothing creates a SITE when a PROJECT launches.
gaps: No canonical PROJECT lifecycle including post-launch states (LAUNCHED -> LIVE_MAINTENANCE/CARE -> EVOLVING -> DORMANT -> ARCHIVED); launched != deleted is not encoded.
No SITE entity lifecycle or creation at launch; site00_sites effectively demo-only.
/control/sites shows fake seed data to real clients; MANAGE links 404->home.

Public /sites empty with no showcase-approval authority; /sites/:id unrouted.
SITES placed under CONTROL ROOM namespace (/control/sites) and labelled SYSTEMS/INFRASTRUCTURE in admin — neither matches 'digital locations SITE 00 created'.
No domains table; no live_url; no deploy history table.
Existing Location service not tied to site00_sites; EVOLVE not tied to site/project.
status='ACTIVE' filters hide non-ACTIVE projects from CTRL ROOM and team load.
Three disjoint project registries touch sites (site00_projects, site00_managed_projects, static registries).
